_comment: Exact git refs (tag or SHA) of pine-lang and beamlynx-ui bundled into this desktop build. Checked out directly by CI via these refs -- update deliberately as part of a release, per RELEASING.md. pine-lang unchanged since 0.5.0 (still master's merge commit for 0.39.0 -- pine-lang doesn't tag releases, so this is a SHA, not a tag) -- no pine-lang changes since then. beamlynx-ui bumped to its tagged 0.51.0, which bundles the Canvas-first default layout, auto-run, the resizable Pine/SQL panel, browser-style tab switching, and a fix for canvas mode freezing up while that panel was open.
